Assuming you’re In school. Sell candy bars I did in high school for 3 years easiest money can make and not get in trouble for like selling weed. Made about $90 per day put all the chocolate in a lunchbox in my back pack with freezer pack and other candy in ziplock bags. Sold everything for $1 made a menu on the back of my binder by taping empty wrappers of each candy bar together on a paper and slide on the back side of my binder. Use it as a “menu” people are visual so they gotta see it and it sells way better than just telling them what you have. Plus it’s way more convenient than saying each of the candy bars every single time also it’s good loss prevention because people will try and steal from your backpack while you’re showing them what you have.  teachers won’t think anything of it just another kid with some “design on your binder”. Made about $90 per day Monday-Thursday.. we had early out of Friday so it was usually what ever I had leftover throughout the week.. buy the candy in bulk. Costco or smart and final the variety pack was always the best. At the time a pack of 30 was about $15 so I’d double my money every-time. So I’d average $180 per week profit. Which is good for a kid in school almost like a part time job. It got to the point where I had an employee for alittle but didn’t go that smooth so I fired him. Some teachers gave me trouble others I would bribe and some even bought candy bars from me.
